title.ko: 미래 표현: will · be going to · 현재진행형
title.en: Future forms: will · be going to · present continuous

explain.ko: 미래를 나타내는 표현은 쓰임이 다릅니다. be going to는 미리 정한 계획과 눈에 보이는 근거가 있는 예측에, 현재진행형은 시간과 장소까지 정해진 약속에, will은 말하는 순간 정한 결정·제안·약속과 의견에 바탕을 둔 예측에 씁니다. 시간표나 일정은 현재형을 씁니다(The train leaves at 7.15). Shall I / Shall we …?는 제안할 때 씁니다.
explain.en: The future forms are used differently. Use be going to for plans made before speaking and for predictions based on evidence; the present continuous for fixed arrangements with a time or place; and will for decisions made at the moment of speaking, offers, promises and predictions based on opinion. Timetables use the present simple (The train leaves at 7.15). Use Shall I / Shall we …? to make a suggestion.

notes.en: Use the present continuous when the arrangement is made, and be going to when you only intend.

notes.ko: probably는 will 뒤, won't 앞에 둡니다: It'll probably rain. It probably won't rain.
notes.en: Probably goes after will and before won't: It'll probably rain. It probably won't rain.
